pages.text: It is necessary to summon Leviathan. Instead of Crystallized coral, you can use a piece of coral. Athame falls from the Deepling Priest, corals from

Coralssus and Amethyst crab. All these creatures are mini-bosses, quite annoying. Especially the Deepling Priest varieties.$(br2)To summon Leviathan, you need to click on the altar in the center of the city floor, holding a heart in your hand.
Attacks with void projectiles and beams. Leviathan is not very strong, but it is difficult to dodge his attacks, so be careful.
